postgame.what_decided_it: Turnovers. Miami outgained Cincinnati 331 to 307 and ran for 217 at 6.4 a pop, but coughed it up three times to the Bengals' one. Burrow turned short fields into four touchdowns.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 23/32, 190 yards, 4 TD, 0 INT. Not a volume day, 5.9 yards per pass, but clean and sharp inside the 20.
Ja'Marr Chase: 6 catches, 77 yards, 1 TD. Still the first read that always works.
Per the ESPN recap headline, Battle had a pair of interceptions. Malik Willis finished 15/27, 137 yards, 1 TD, 2 INT.
postgame.division_meaning: Baltimore sits 4-1 on a W3 run. Cincinnati, Cleveland and Pittsburgh are all 3-2. The Bengals' +19 point differential is second in the North behind the Ravens' +27.
postgame.the_take: A win over an 0-5 team that you got outgained in is not a fix. Ben Baby's piece says the Bengals know they can play better. Giving up 217 on the ground travels badly to Baltimore on Mon, 26 Oct, 1:00 am.
